summary: Comprehensive testing of SubSidekick MVP (voice-first AI foreman app). Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed (auth, jobs, change orders, back charges, inspections, digest, LLM briefing, chat with change-order/back-charge draft creation, PATCH status, TTS + audio streaming). Frontend: Login screen renders, demo signin works, all 4 tabs (Briefing/Talk/Jobs/Office) load, LLM briefing summary displays correctly, 3 seeded jobs list with progress bars, job detail navigation works, Office digest sub-tabs (Change Orders/Back Charges/Inspections) work, Approve/Reject buttons function on change orders, Talk tab shows chat history from backend.

issues: Signout button testID='signout-button' is only rendered on the Briefing tab header — not on Talk/Jobs/Office tab headers. Users must navigate back to Briefing to sign out. Consider hoisting signout into the tab layout header for consistency.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Move signout button into the shared tab layout so it is reachable from every screen, not just Briefing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~600 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth.py, jobs.py, chat.py, voice.py) once feature-set stabilizes.
chat/send heuristic always attaches drafts to jobs[0] — good for MVP but should later parse job name/context.
Auth error responses use generic 401 messages (Missing token/Invalid session/Session expired) — good.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded via projection everywhere.
All models use uuid string IDs (not ObjectId) — JSON-safe.
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY properly loaded from env; LLM failures gracefully fall back to canned text.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows verified; signout reachability minor)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests reused the existing demo user 'demo@subsidekick.com' (seeded via /api/auth/dev-login). No manual seeding required. Tests added 1 change-order draft and 1 back-charge draft via chat pipeline (verifying auto-draft heuristic).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py exercises auth, all CRUD, digest, LLM briefing, chat draft-creation heuristic, PATCH status, and TTS+audio streaming. Reuse via: `pytest backend/tests/test_backend_api.py -v`. Frontend demo login via testID='demo-signin-button' on login screen. Signout only lives on Briefing tab header (testID='signout-button').
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs blocking release. Signout reachability is a UX design choice, not a bug.
